scope: Remove executable NGE expertise modifiers from the active Publish 14.1 crafting, resource sampling, structure-management, and retained cybernetic-crafting paths while preserving authored PRE-CU skill, resource, structure, and experimentation behavior.

findings: The pinned Publish 14.1 implementation has no expertise system or expertise-derived crafting modifiers.
The inherited active crafting path still allowed NGE expertise modifiers to raise resource-quality caps, alter experimentation rolls, and reduce crafted-item complexity.
Resource sampling and structure placement/load still allowed NGE expertise modifiers to increase sampling yield, extraction rate, hopper size, and reduce power or maintenance costs.
The retained cybernetic crafting path allowed an NGE expertise modifier to reduce its authored protection penalty.
Persisted factory and harvester power-expertise objvars are removed when the compatibility helper runs so stale later-era state cannot remain authoritative.

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: all 11 active NGE expertise-modifier reads in the shared crafting, sampling, structure-management, and retained cybernetic-crafting calculation surface
auditBoundary.preserved: resource weighting, crafting inspiration, city and food adjustments, Force experimentation, Publish 14.1 Luck, ordinary crafting skill mods, authored deed extraction/hopper/power values, structure maintenance and factory-efficiency mods, TCG sampling content, and the retained cybernetic base penalty
auditBoundary.notClaimedComplete: other retained NGE buffs, TCG bonuses, and dormant or content-specific expertise references remain subject to later reachability audits
